title: Anthropic Agent Skills
description: Anthropic's public repository of example Agent Skills (document creation, MCP server generation, brand/design workflows, and more) plus the Agent Skills spec and a starter template.

title: Claude Cookbooks
description: Anthropic's official collection of copy-paste recipes for building with Claude, including agent and sub-agent patterns, tool use, and prompt caching.

title: Model Context Protocol Servers
description: The official MCP steering group's reference server implementations (filesystem, git, memory, fetch, and more) demonstrating how to build MCP servers that give agents tool access.

title: Awesome MCP Servers
description: A large, actively-maintained community-curated list of MCP servers across many categories and languages. Broad and unvetted by design — read before you point an agent at anything in it.
